pacer

pacer sets itself up in a terminal tab named pacer. Follow the prompts there.

Didn't see it?

  1. Install pacer:curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamtuanvu/pacer/main/install.sh | sh
  2. Finish setup:~/.local/bin/pacer init

Get the live panel

pacer init's last step adds ~/.pacer/orca-plugin under Settings > Plugins > Development. Add that folder and enable pacer to see setup checks, budgets and tasks.

After the live panel connects, this marketplace copy goes quiet and can be uninstalled.

pacer won't touch your agents' settings until you approve it.
